# Northwind Labs pushes for rush timelines but never renegotiates fee

On every engagement so far, Northwind Labs has asked to compress the interview window —
usually from three weeks down to two — right after the scope is signed. They've never once
asked for a lower fee to match, which means the ask is about their internal launch calendar,
not price sensitivity. Worth remembering before defaulting to a rush surcharge with them —
the better move is to quote the trade-off in interview count, not money.

**Source:** Ana's kickoff-call notes, Q2–Q3 2026 engagements
**Date:** 2026-07-20

Related: [[hold-the-fee-negotiate-scope]]
